answer:
**Overall score: 93, band Managed.** The assessment ran fresh on "World Cup PostgreSQL" (9 entities, 12 findings).

**Weakest dimensions**
- **Timeliness: 60.** This is the lowest score. It checks whether each table's newest record is less than 365 days old. All 5 checks found a problem.
- **Completeness: 81.** This checks how many nullable columns have missing values. It has 7 findings, 6 of them high severity.
- Consistency, integrity, uniqueness, reasonability and accessibility all scored 100.
- Validity scored 100, but it ran 0 checks. The engine found no email, phone, URL, UUID or date-like text columns to test, so that score doesn't show validity was verified.
- Accuracy and currency are not assessed because they need reference data.

**Most severe findings**

The most severe findings are in completeness, but timeliness is the weaker dimension by score.

| Severity | Table | Column | Measured | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| High | goals | assist_player_id | 95.7% null (45/47) | Confirm the column is still populated upstream, or mark it optional. |
| High | matches | group_letter | 100% null (16/16) | Same as above. |
| High | matches | home_penalties, away_penalties | 75% null (12/16) each | Same as above. |
| High | v_match_results | home_penalties, away_penalties | 75% null (12/16) each | Same as above. |
| Medium | matches | kicked_off_at | Newest record is 1422 days old (2022-12-18) | Confirm the table is still being loaded. |
| Medium | tournaments | ends_on | Newest record is 1423 days old (2022-12-18) | Same as above. |
| Medium | players | date_of_birth | Newest record is 9057 days old | Same as above. |
| Medium | v_match_results, v_player_goal_totals | kicked_off_at, tournament_year | 1422 and 1409 days old | Same as above. |
| Low | v_player_goal_totals | first_goal_minute | 2.8% null (1/36) | Investigate the source of the missing values or document them as expected. |

**How to read this**
- The data's latest record is the 2022 final, so the timeliness findings fit a historical dataset. They only matter if you expect newer tournaments.
- The `players.date_of_birth` finding follows from how the check works. Birth dates are never recent.
- Penalty columns are probably null because most matches don't go to a shootout. `assist_player_id` is probably null because most goals have no assist. Both would be expected nulls, but the engine can't tell expected nulls from missing data.
- `matches.group_letter` is null in every row, so it's worth checking whether it was ever loaded.
